The '''Adumar system''', also known as the '''Katorrs system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].
